name: 29154 · Sumter, SC
findings: ZIP 29154 (Sumter) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29154 (Sumter) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29154 (Sumter) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 33 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
